post.description: Bounded chat subset; unsupported fields return 400. max_tokens and max_completion_tokens are mutually exclusive. Tool/vision/structured-output capability is checked against the selected mapping. After output begins, no replay/fallback occurs. Unknown usage leaves settlement pending, never a zero-cost claim.

parameters.description: Non-empty UUID, scoped to organization/key/operation for 24 hours. Replay returns 409 and X-Original-Request-Id; completion bodies are not replayed.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

items.description: Content is required except assistant tool-call messages. Only user messages accept HTTPS image URLs; only assistant messages accept tool_calls; tool messages require tool_call_id and one text content part.

uzllm.description: provider_key_id must be non-empty. Managed fallback opt-in requires provider_key_id. Fallback codes must be canonical and distinct from the requested model; BYOK cross-model fallback requires Managed opt-in.

200.description: JSON completion or SSE data frames. A complete stream ends with data: [DONE]. Interrupted streams use event: error with the error envelope; HTTP status cannot change after headers. Usage/finish/tool/refusal chunks may appear before the terminal marker.

post.description: Stateless text Responses JSON/SSE subset, translated through existing chat adapters. input accepts text or 1–256 text message items (including instructions). stream is optional boolean; store must be false or omitted; no conversation retrieval, tools, vision, structured-output or reasoning controls. Unsupported fields return 400 before reservation/dispatch. Missing usage is null and remains pending evidence, not zero cost. Existing authorization, limits, routing, BYOK/Hybrid consent and financial controls apply. Idempotency operation is responses, separate from chat.completions.

parameters.description: Non-empty UUID, scoped to organization/key/operation for 24 hours. Replay returns 409 and X-Original-Request-Id; completion bodies are not replayed.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Stateless text subset. Instructions plus input count <=256; JSON property names must be unique at each object.

uzllm.description: provider_key_id must be non-empty. Managed fallback opt-in requires provider_key_id. Fallback codes must be canonical and distinct from the requested model; BYOK cross-model fallback requires Managed opt-in.

200.description: JSON response or named Responses SSE events (ResponsesStreamEvent schema), not chat chunks/[DONE]. Sequence numbers start at zero. Terminal response.completed/incomplete follows upstream closure and financial cleanup; response.failed reports partial-stream/finalization errors. Unknown usage is null, never zero. No fallback after output. Streaming terminal snapshots retain at most 1048576 text/refusal characters; exceeding the bound fails safely, never truncates as success.
